decisions.rationale: Intended Mega is Charizard Y. Charizard-Venusaur immediately establishes sun, doubles Venusaur’s Speed, and threatens sleep plus strong Grass damage into likely Water/Rock selections. Garchomp gives the cleanest Archaludon/Garganacl damage from the back, while Raichu supplies Fake Out and Lightning Rod utility versus Archaludon or Politoed.

Intended answer to Mega Charizard-Y is Politoed Drizzle — slower than Charizard-Y so rain overrides Drought. Lead Politoed+Noivern: Politoed Weather Ball (Water 100BP STAB 2x SE in rain) can OHKO Charizard-Y even if Noivern is flinched by Fake Out. Noivern at 192 Speed outspeeds the entire opponent roster bar Talonflame, and Hurricane is 100% accurate in rain. Focus Sash guarantees Noivern survives turn 1. decisions.notebook: Series tied 1-1, Game 3 decisive. Opponent Game 2 bring: Charizard-Y, Garchomp, Raichu, Goodra-Hisui; benched Venusaur, Talonflame. Opponent patterns: Raichu for Fake Out+Encore+Lightning Rod support; Charizard-Y as Mega sun nuke; Goodra-Hisui as Sap Sipper special wall with Leftovers. Key Game 3 facts verified: Politoed Drizzle overrides Charizard-Y Drought (Politoed slower = rain wins). Politoed Weather Ball in rain (Water 100BP STAB 2x SE) can OHKO Charizard-Y (65.9-141.2%). Garganacl Rock Slide 4x SE vs Charizard-Y can OHKO even as spread (65.9-147.1%). Noivern Hurricane 100% accuracy in rain, 192 Speed outspeeds entire opponent roster except Talonflame (160-195). Staraptor Close Combat (Expert Belt 2x SE) can OHKO Goodra-Hisui (50.8-111%). Noivern outspeeds Raichu on non-priority moves so Encore can only lock after Noivern already attacked — Hurricane lock is acceptable in rain, switch resets. If opponent brings Talonflame for Tailwind, pivot to Garganacl Rock Slide (4x SE vs both Charizard-Y and Talonflame). My team has no Mega — must leverage rain+speed+4x SE Rock Slide to close power gap.

decisions.rationale: Mega Evolving immediately replaces rain with sun and guarantees Solar Beam KOs Politoed if it stays in, while reducing Hurricane to 50% accuracy. If Politoed Protects, Sleep Powder can punish Noivern after its attack and preserves the favorable sun endgame. Venusaur’s Sash covers a Hurricane hit.
decisions.notebook: Opponent’s Noivern is Timid Focus Sash Infiltrator with Hurricane, Draco Meteor, Super Fang, and Protect. Garganacl can be constrained with Encore. Mega Y is a strong endgame answer to Garganacl because Drought enables immediate Solar Beam, even through the opponent’s screen-oriented game plan.

decisions.rationale: Venusaur outspeeds Politoed and Leaf Storm can OHKO (76-138%). Protecting Politoed guarantees rain stays while Noivern Hurricane breaks Venusaur's Sash at 100% rain accuracy. Turn 2: Ice Beam KOs 1-HP Venusaur + Weather Ball hits Charizard-Y for 2x SE. If opponent double Protects, both their Protects are spent for next turn.
decisions.notebook: Game 3 decisive. Opponent lead Charizard+Venusaur (sun core weakened by rain). Venusaur Focus Sash + Leaf Storm can OHKO Politoed (76-138%) and outspeeds it (100-132 vs 90). Must keep Politoed alive to maintain rain vs Charizard-Y Drought. Turn 2 plan: Ice Beam KOs Sash-broken Venusaur, Weather Ball 2x SE Charizard. Garganacl on bench: Rock Slide 4x SE vs Charizard-Y/Talonflame, Purifying Salt immune to Sleep Powder, Wide Guard for spread protection. If opponent brings Talonflame for Tailwind, pivot to Garganacl. Staraptor Close Combat 2x SE vs Goodra-Hisui. Noivern Focus Sash intact if not targeted turn 1.

decisions.rationale: Solar Beam removes Politoed before it can act if it stays, preserving sun and denying Weather Ball or Helping Hand. Sleep Powder is the best cover for a Noivern wake: Venusaur moves first and has a 75% chance to re-disable it. If Politoed switches, Solar Beam still pressures the incoming slot while Noivern remains constrained.

Politoed is outsped by both foes and OHKO'd by 2x SE Grass if it stays. Staraptor resists Grass 0.5x as slot a switch-in. Noivern is asleep and useless; Garganacl enters slot b immune to Sleep Powder (Purifying Salt), resists Heat Wave (16-35%), and threatens Rock Slide 4x SE vs Charizard-Y next turn. Opponent most likely targets slot a with Grass to KO Politoed—Staraptor absorbs it. Next turn: Staraptor Brave Bird Venusaur (76-174%), Garganacl Rock Slide Charizard-Y (4x SE).

decisions.notebook: Game 3 decisive. Opponent Raichu carries Encore and uses it to punish Protect users—expect Encore whenever a foe just Protected. Raichu has no Protect in its moveset. Raichu Thunderbolt does 33–52% to Noivern (17% KO at 49% HP) and 41–76% to Politoed. Politoed Weather Ball in rain (STAB Water 100 BP) does 50–96% to Raichu—huge chunk, Sitrus heals Raichu back to 29–75%. Plan: KO Venusaur at 1% with Noivern Hurricane, chunk Raichu with Politoed Weather Ball, then clean up Raichu next turn before dealing with Charizard endgame. Keep Noivern spa intact—do not use Draco Meteor unless it secures a KO. Rain has 2 turns left; if Charizard enters, sun replaces rain and Weather Ball becomes Fire-type.

decisions.rationale: Double Politoed now: both listed attacks are super effective, and Thunderbolt plus Leaf Storm covers its remaining HP despite Venusaur’s drops. If Politoed Protects, rain expires and Charizard can later reset sun; Politoed cannot remove both attackers this turn.

If opponent predicts Protect and Encores, I'm locked but alive; if they Thunderbolt, I survive to next turn. No other play keeps me in the game.

Switching Charizard safely resets sun as rain ends, preserves Venusaur, and sets up Solar Beam pressure while Politoed remains Encore-locked into consecutive Protects.

Noivern was Timid Focus Sash Infiltrator with Hurricane, Draco Meteor, Super Fang, Protect. Mega Charizard Y can reset sun after Politoed’s rain and should be preserved for that role.

decisions.rationale: Game is nearly lost at 1v4 with Raichu outspeeding and OHKOing. If opponent Thunderbolts, I die regardless. If they Encore expecting Protect, Weather Ball KOs Raichu (confirmed45.5-106.7%, guaranteed KO at 32%). Protect is strictly worse: even at 33% success, Raichu still KOs me next turn. Attacking Raichu is the only line with any upside.

Politoed is locked into Protect and has no partner. Raichu moves first and Thunderbolt is a guaranteed KO if Protect fails; Charizard Protect preserves its PP and cannot be punished by an attacking Politoed this turn.

reflections.summary: Won because the Charizard-Y/Raichu/Venusaur/Garchomp four matched their rain-centered bring well: Drought removed Drizzle value, Raichu repeatedly Encored Politoed’s Protect, and Charizard eventually finished it with Solar Beam. Mega Charizard Y was the correct intended Mega and the chosen four were suited to this opponent.
reflections.adjustment: Next game, keep the Charizard Y + Raichu anti-Politoed plan, but Encore Protect earlier and then redirect attacks to its partner rather than repeatedly doubling into protected Politoed.
reflections.notebook: Politoed is a Protect-heavy Drizzle support set with Weather Ball, Ice Beam, Helping Hand, and Sitrus Berry; it can be exploited by Encore under Grass/Electric pressure. Preserve Mega Charizard Y as the weather-reset win condition against Politoed-based rain plans, ideally supported by Raichu Encore.

reflections.summary: Lost the weather war at team preview. Bringing Politoed (Drizzle) against Mega Charizard Y (Drought) handed the opponent permanent weather control once Charizard mega-evolved, neutering Weather Ball and enabling Venusaur's Chlorophyll. Politoed then got Encore-locked into Protect by Raichu for four turns, effectively removing any agency while Charizard freely charged Solar Beams. Garganacl and Staraptor never meaningfully contributed. The four brought and the rain plan were fundamentally mismatc
reflections.adjustment: Do not bring Politoed-dependent rain into a confirmed Charizard-Y series. If Charizard-Y is in preview, lead with weather-independent answers—Garganacl's Wide Guard for Heat Wave, priority or speed control to pressure Venusaur before Chlorophyll activates, and a dedicated Charizard answer. Avoid consecutive Protect calls against a Raichu that has shown Encore.

Charizard-Mega-Y Drought overrides Drizzle on Mega Evo; Weather Ball shifts to Fire in sun. Without sun, Solar Beam reverts to 2-turn charge. Drizzle does NOT re-activate when opposing weather expires — only on switch-in. Thunderbolt on Politoed at 67% is NOT a guaranteed KO (46–70% range). Politoed Ice Beam vs Garchomp: possible OHKO not guaranteed. Opponent left out Talonflame and Goodra-Hisui in game 3. Plan: never bring Politoed rain into Charizard-Y sun; use weather-independent countermeasures instead.
